name: OWASP Agentic AI Security Guidance
description: Security guidance addressing the emerging attack surface of autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, tool-calling capabilities, execution environments, and autonomous decision-making.
applicability_conditions: AI systems featuring autonomous agents, multi-agent communication, tool execution, or dynamic planning

requirements.title: Agent Privilege Escalation and Authorization Boundary Failure
requirements.normalized_requirement: AI agents shall be assigned scoped, short-lived credentials and operate within defined role-based boundaries, preventing agents from acquiring unauthorized access across systems or tenants.
requirements.applicability: Autonomous agents accessing APIs or infrastructure
requirements.implementation_guidance: Grant ephemeral tokens per tool call and sandbox agent identity within tenant boundaries.

requirements.title: Insecure Tool Execution and Tool Poisoning
requirements.normalized_requirement: Tools and APIs invoked by agents shall validate all parameters independently, prevent command injection, and verify tool definitions against tampering or supply-chain poisoning.
requirements.applicability: Agents invoking external tools or APIs
requirements.implementation_guidance: Perform server-side validation of all agent-generated function arguments and restrict dangerous system commands.

requirements.title: Memory and Context Poisoning
requirements.normalized_requirement: Agent long-term memory and scratchpad contexts shall be isolated, validated, and sanitized to prevent indirect manipulation through injected memories or malicious retrieval.
requirements.applicability: Agents with persistent memory or vector store state
requirements.implementation_guidance: Authenticate memory updates and prevent unauthenticated write access to agent memory stores.

requirements.title: Human Oversight and Emergency Kill-Switch for Autonomous Agents
requirements.normalized_requirement: Every autonomous agent capable of executing actions in production or external systems shall possess an instantaneous, immutable kill-switch and require explicit human approval for high-risk actions.
requirements.implementation_guidance: Build an administrative kill switch that immediately revokes agent tokens and halts active workflows.
